records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Revenue increased 5% for both the three and six months ended March 31, 2025 compared to the corresponding periods in the prior fiscal year, driven by revenue growth in both our Sample Management Solutions and Multiomics segments.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: As of March 31, 2025, we had non-cancellable commitments of $57.2 million comprised of purchase orders for inventory of $44.2 million and other operating expense commitments of $13.0 million.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: In total, we employ approximately 3,000 full-time employees, part-time employees and contingent workers worldwide as of March 31, 2025 and have sales in approximately 86 countries.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 46% for both the three and six months ended March 31, 2025 compared to 44% for both the corresponding periods in the prior fiscal year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating income for the Sample Management Solutions segment was $0.6 million and $2.1 million, respectively, for the three and six months ended March 31, 2025 compared to an operating loss of $2.9 million and $4.4 million, respectively, in the corresponding periods in the prior fiscal year.
